6265c5aee95cd7afdb551316878409a0e53c4f17.QuestDescription: Freya's Sigil is going to be one of the tougher ones, I reckon.$B$BAccording to the Archivum, the essence of the Sigil is tied to her three elder servants, Brightleaf, Ironbranch and Stonebark. 62b21e551c5812018684794bf15a525f6267e4d4.LogDescription: Kill the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, then return to Seereth Stonebreak at the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens.
62b21e551c5812018684794bf15a525f6267e4d4.QuestDescription: There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shaman and the natural magic of druids.  This is why we shaman can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon.  Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...$B$BI saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed.  These metal beasts must be stopped!$B$BIn my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:$B$BXT:4 and XT:9.

62b234bb68b994a3efecb6beccff3942460bba81.LogDescription: Kill 6 Mana Serpents and 6 Ether Fiends and return to Groundskeeper Wyllithen at Duskwither Grounds in Eversong Woods.
62b234bb68b994a3efecb6beccff3942460bba81.QuestDescription: It's horrible, I tell you! Strange things happening in the spire, the magister and his apprentices run off, and then the next thing that you know, the whole grounds are overrun with these magical beasties! And who told Wyllithen? No one, that's who!$B$B$C, you've got to help me clear some of these things out... I cannot maintain the grounds while these 'anomalies' are running amok!

62b8fdabd3457fbe9bf8e8666c988f0d73a7d922.RewardText: Your help here's a boon, $N. You're cutting my time spent here in Desolace by half at least. I'll be back in Ironforge warming my feet in no time with your help.$B$BWhen we get this list taken care of, and I'm back home, look me up, I'll buy you an ale for sure.$B$BBut until then, let's get the rest of these reagents gathered.

62cae1f3bb5514f5ca2aefafa94945a972a922a3.LogDescription: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
62cae1f3bb5514f5ca2aefafa94945a972a922a3.LogTitle: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
62cae1f3bb5514f5ca2aefafa94945a972a922a3.QuestDescription: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.$B$BLater, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.

62cdecc699ea13e8490338a284d1c8663ceef3e3.Text: Alert! Alert! Construct senses that enemies have breeched our defenses. Increase pace.

62d0941457458b84de49d3f2c7d1653f22f48f1a.Text: I'd like to see the Alliance try to steal our flame.

62d7e05665be98cd18421bbb84ee4ed092445252.LogDescription: Sasha at the White Pine Trading Post wants you to take the Tranquilizer Dart and use it on Tatjana in Solstice Village.  Bring Tatjana back to the White Pine Trading Post.
62d7e05665be98cd18421bbb84ee4ed092445252.QuestDescription: My sister is here somewhere, and I can't seem to get this monster to talk.$B$BHe doesn't seem to care about his own well-being, but I've an idea.  I knew Anatoly's wife, Tatjana, from before the wolfcult arrived -- she was a horse-handler.$B$BTake this tranquillizer dart.  Bring her back alive, we're going to need her if we're to have any leverage with Anatoly.$B$BI will help you find the person behind all this once we save my sister.

62d8fc10c4e234981d8860eb14ca28221343a261.Text: I don't know which is worse, getting eaten by fel orcs or working for that slave master Razelcraz! Oh well, thanks anyways!

62d9560c195d5ae09160dea89c414bd92fd795d3.RewardText: There they are! And in such a nice container. The perfect size!$b$bWe'll keep these eggs in a safe place so we can study them later, but right now we need that thing you brought them in.$b$bI have created a device with a very specific use: to destroy the undead scholars of the Scholomance. They are studying dragons in their efforts to create a plagued dragonflight, and we must halt their progress.$b$bI call the device Dawn's Gambit, because... I'm not sure if it works!$b$bWill you find out for us?

62d9a281c2151a3d3eaa5d559dbf0948f559d84d.LogDescription: Kill Bronjahm and the Devourer of Souls to secure access to the Pit of Saron.
62d9a281c2151a3d3eaa5d559dbf0948f559d84d.QuestDescription: I cannot thank you enough for coming. We're severely undermanned to be risking a venture into the citadel, but opportunities like this are too rare to pass up.$B$BI'm awaiting the arrival of champions from the coliseum, but if your reputation holds true, you should be more than equipped to fight through the forge yourself. Clear the way to the far side and secure the passage to the Pit of Saron. We will need to hold it to move our men further into the citadel.$B$BPlease hurry, $n. We're counting on you.

62da61a3149d9c572c2ef75bc40fd58294967eb3.RewardText: I never dreamed any would be skilled enough to defeat Skyshatter. You do know what this means, right? You are now the top orc! You must defend your title.

62ddd0b7b2380031d65d55f57511a545e3390f9f.LogDescription: Collect 5 Sanguine Hibiscus and return them to Gzhun'tt at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.
62ddd0b7b2380031d65d55f57511a545e3390f9f.QuestDescription: We must replenish our supply of sanguine hibiscus, which we use for a number of purposes.  They used to grow thick as shrubs, but the lowering of the marsh's water levels means that they can only be found now in the Underbog at Coilfang Reservoir, under Serpent Lake.$B$BIt is said that the shamblers, bog giants, and underbats there consider them a delicacy.  So, if you are to help us, you must retrieve the flowers from them.

62e6cc3bac5f72c1ef9ab7748fd1b7c4d5994f94.RewardText: $N, you have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. The Argent Crusade and all who gather here are in our debt and we'll make certain they remember it. For all their bluster about providing protection, the peacekeepers and skytalons spend more time breaking up drunken brawls than keeping us safe from the Scourge.$b$bIt's no matter. We always protect our own.

62eae1ce944ec09e68c91a0c57adec14c82b307d.Text: Say, Brend, whisper me somethin' sweet, will ya?

62f12ab9c6b2b7f24f969bb354eac1242cc7c8f4.RewardText: YOU DID IT! YOU SAVED US! YOU SAVED THE ALLERIAN STRONGHOLD!!$B$BWith their forces decimated, their leader dead and the mana bomb destroyed, we can all breathe much easier now.$B$B$N, I've never seen such selflessness... such heroism! Please, accept this on behalf of all of us.

62f156cdd35757a1c00997c51d1703e20f8982cc.LogDescription: Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.$B$BFeed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
62f156cdd35757a1c00997c51d1703e20f8982cc.QuestDescription: Help, $N! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.$B$BWill you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.$B$BTo feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.

62f1bf1c3c24226fd106c9af77a6dea5cc63350e.RewardText: It is strange that the Warchief would expend so much over such a small thing. I do not claim to understand him, but I will follow him, whatever his commands. You did well, $N, no doubt the Warchief will be glad to hear of your success.

62feaafb67c328427585c9acc7471b81186153bc.LogDescription: Bring Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic to High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind.
62feaafb67c328427585c9acc7471b81186153bc.QuestDescription: Long ago, three mages studied in this tower until one fell to the dark arts.  He was urged to turn away from that evil magic, but he could not resist.  And so he was banished.$B$BThe fallen mage's new domain is the tower of Ilgalar in Redridge, and he took with him a powerful book--Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.$B$BWe, the mages of Stormwind, would have that book returned.  Enter the tower of Ilgalar, find the tome in his library, and bring it to me.

62ffc9d033422383b2da175978c69a4e1b78c86a.RewardText: It is doubtful that the orcs will understand or appreciate what you just did but Nagrand is better off for the deed. Thank you, problem solver...
